verdict.rationale: Per-user search restriction is a fair axis for a search engine, but the evidence pack never documents scoped or tenant API keys, document-level security, or filtered tokens that limit each user to their own documents within a shared index. The only nearby item is a passing community mention of a proprietary 'fine-grained access control' add-on. It does not describe per-user document scoping or tokens, so it cannot support this story.
